label: coach_teacher_history_first_00
text: This school... It’s filled with the smell of the new,\nthe modern.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_first_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So, are you the one who called me here,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_00
text: You’ve got some nerve, inviting me to such a\nmodern structure.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_01
text: I have absolutely no interest in this place, but I\ndidn’t want you to lose face—so here I am.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_02
text: Think of it as a favor from me. Heh heh...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_03
text: I’ll expect you to return the favor at some point.\nPerhaps by doing as I say when needed.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_select_01
text: Oh no...

label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_select_02
text: You got it!

label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_05
text: Heh! You reap what you sow. I suggest you look\nforward to the harvest![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_05b
text: Hm? You’re more enthusiastic than I expected.\nWhich suits me just fine. Heh heh...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_04
text: Oh, the things we can accomplish together, my\ndear puppet...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_00
text: Ah, you again. I suppose whatever you’ve done\nsince we last spoke has become a part of history.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_01
text: Initially I took the long journey here unwillingly,\nbut...when I think about it, we’re in Unova!\c\nThis place is a veritable treasure trove of history![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_02
text: I am practically overflowing with curiosity,\nespecially regarding those ancient ruins resting at\r\nthe bottom of the sea![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_03
text: ...And Director Clavell isn’t here to snoop around\nin my business—another perk of this trip.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_04
text: Ohohooo! I can’t wait to have a swim with my\nPokémon and go exploring![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_select_01
text: Sounds like fun!

label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_select_02
text: Be safe out there

label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_05
text: Heh heh! Of course it will be fun!\c\nThere is no greater treasure than experiencing\nancient wisdom![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_05b
text: Heh heh, don’t worry yourself about me.\c\nShould I meet my end surrounded by ruins and\nartifacts...it would be a good way to go.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_select_01
text: What’s up?

label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_select_02
text: Something wrong?

label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_01
text: Isn’t it obvious? I’m exhausted by the sheer\nbliss of satisfaction and fulfillment.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_01b
text: Heh... No, the exact opposite. So many things\nare right that I am exhausted from satisfaction.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_02
text: I took my Lumineon for a swim and visited the\nfamous Abyssal Ruins here in Unova...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_03
text: They were...marvelous. Truly amazing.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_04
text: Ancient contrivances to thwart intruders! The\nmysterious text etched onto the walls![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_05
text: Testing my wits against those of the ancients was\na truly rewarding experience.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_06
text: But it would be a shame to dash straight to the\ndepths of the ruins too quickly. I plan on taking\r\nmy time with the exploration.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_trade_01_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You know, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]... I
just
had
an
amusing idea.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_trade_01_01
text: You are a Champion, aren’t you? What say you\nand I trade Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_trade_01_02
text: Any Pokémon belonging to a Champion is sure\nto be incredibly useful. So...would you be willing\r\nto trade for my Gimmighoul?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_trade_01_03
text: Excellent. Then you should pick which Pokémon\nyou want to trade. A species good at exploring\r\nwould be appreciated.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_trade_01_04
text: Ah yes. A worthwhile trade.\c\nDon’t you worry. I’ll take very good care of your\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)].[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_trade_02_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Are you ready to trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] for\nmy\r\nGimmighoul?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_trade_02_01
text: You can’t trade Ms. Raifort a Pokémon if you\naren’t its original Trainer!

label: coach_teacher_history_trade_02_02
text: You can’t trade Ms. Raifort such a rare Pokémon!

label: coach_teacher_history_trade_02_03
text: You can’t trade Ms. Raifort a Shiny Pokémon!

label: coach_teacher_history_trade_03_00
text:
...Ah, but I see you only have one Pokémon along
with you at the moment.\c
You would be wise to put at least two Pokémon
in your party before agreeing to a trade.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_trade_03_01
text: History is full of deals refused and then later\naccepted. I trust you’ll have a change of heart.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_trade_04_00
text: So, how about you trade me one of your\nPokémon for my Gimmighoul?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_talkto_00
text: I’ve been stuck indoors here for far too long.\nThis...smell of newness is driving me mad.\c\nWhat do you say we head outdoors for a battle?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_cancel_00
text: Hm. I’d assumed you’d be more eager about this\nsort of thing. Perhaps I shall head out alone.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_battlestart_00
text: Heh heh... How very kind of you. Let’s make our\nway to the battlefield, then.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_battlestart_01
text: [EMPTY 59]

label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_win_00_00
text: You certainly are a worthy opponent. I see the\npath you’ve walked is one of glory and power.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_win_00_01
text: Such strength... It would open all manner of ruins\nand ancient tombs to me! If I could only secure\r\nyour cooperation...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_win_00_02
text: Ah, of course... Here, I’ve got a gift for you. You\nknow, out of the kindness of my heart.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_win_00_03
text: It’s very valuable, you know. Don’t forget to\nthank me each night as you gaze upon it.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_reward_00
text: [EMPTY 59]

label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_win_01_00
text: Heh heh... Yes, yes, your strength will definitely\nbe most useful to me.\c\nHere, another bribe—I mean, gift for you.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_win_01_01
text: I certainly hope you treasure these little moments\nspent with your dear teacher Raifort.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_lose_00_00
text:
Those with great strength often grow arrogant,
which in turn leads to their downfall.\c
Were you trying to experience such a historical
twist of fate yourself?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_randomtalk_00
text:
Are you keeping those treasures of ruin under
control?\c
If you ever feel the need to pass them on to
someone else, I’m always available.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_randomtalk_01
text:
Is it true that you entered the Great Crater of
Paldea?\c
If so, I may borrow some of your time to discuss
your findings. Just a few days in my custody.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_randomtalk_02
text:
I admit the Terarium is an impressive work of
technology, but...\c
It’s all twisted nature with no weight of history
behind it. I find no joy in that, personally.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_randomtalk_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] is proving to be very
useful,
just
as
I
had
expected.\c
It has been a great help to my research and
exploration of ruins.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: coach_teacher_history_randomtalk_04
text:
I enjoy collecting antiques and ancient artifacts.\c
The Gimmighoul I gave you was becoming a bit
of a problem, actually—it was always begging for
old coins from my collection.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
